provenance.gate.tau_accept: frozen 2026-08-02: LFW1 YuNet STANDALONE (box-cropped) LBPH-only sweep, rank-165 unidirectional unique-pair impostor distance (9.986 ppm FAR, native predict_collect scale), reports/independence/lbph_lfw1/native_predict_scale_yunet.json. Unified with cv_only's threshold by design decision (see docs/independence/MASTER_FILE.md row 1/4 and docs/audits/STATE-08-02.md): tau_accept is a single-engine LBPH-marginal-distribution question (SFace never runs before this gate), so no joint/cascade-specific derivation is needed. The previous joint-hybrid candidate (77.769348, docs/READ THIS/FROZEN_THRESHOLDS_HYBRID.md) was NOT adopted -- it was measured on a harness bug (full-frame LBPH tiles instead of box-cropped, see cv-workspace-map SS3.2) which this session's like-for-like YuNet standalone box-crop result (67.033, nearly identical to the old Haar-standalone 67.0084) empirically confirms was the real cause of that gap, not detector choice as FROZEN_THRESHOLDS_HYBRID.md originally claimed.
provenance.gate.tau_reject: frozen 2026-08-01: LFW1 YuNet joint hybrid run rank-165,226 unidirectional unique-pair impostor distance (~1.0% FAR), docs/READ THIS/FROZEN_THRESHOLDS_HYBRID.md. CAUTION 2026-08-02: this value comes from the same full-frame joint run whose LBPH tau_accept sibling (77.769348) was just shown to be a box-crop harness-bug artifact -- 88.4927 is very likely tainted the same way and is NOT yet re-derived on the corrected box-cropped pipeline. Re-derivation is open (docs/NOTES.md item 3); do not treat 88.4927 as trustworthy in the interim, and note the right criterion is probably NOT a plain impostor-tail rank (see docs/audits/STATE-08-02.md and docs/independence/MASTER_FILE.md cross-reference).

_hybrid_sface_band_diagnostic._note: DIAGNOSTIC ONLY -- not read by load_thresholds() or any runtime path, not adoption-grade. See docs/experiments/hybrid_sface_threshold/ANALYSIS.md for the full caveats: band-conditioned n (~69k) is far short of the 16.5M pairs behind the standalone SFace sweep, and 'impostor in-band' here is a 1:1-protocol proxy for the real 1-to-N argmin escalation event, not the event itself. Contingent on a tau_reject (140.13, heavy-tier p99) that has NOT been promoted to canon.
_hybrid_sface_band_diagnostic.finding: cosine_genuine=0.363 is the dominant constraint on the escalation-band population, not l2_genuine -- 12.31% of genuine in-band pairs fail cosine alone (tau_reject=140.13). Raising l2_genuine from the deployed 1.0313 to this sample's zero-observed-false-accept ceiling (1.0417) buys under 1 percentage point of genuine accept-rate gain (81.58% -> 82.51%).
